failure.action: Connect to Wi-Fi or mobile data that gives IPv4 access, or ask the network's owner whether it does, then try again.
failure.detail: None of this computer's network connections has a route to the internet that DNet Engine can use. It needs an IPv4 route; a network that gives only IPv6 is not supported yet, and a connection that is down has none.
failure.title: No network connection DNet Engine can use
